description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, demonstrating how to check network connectivity and display logs related to connection status, including Wi-Fi or mobile network detection.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that checks network connectivity status and logs the results, demonstrating usage of Android's ConnectivityManager and custom logging framework.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout content, prepares the intro fragment, and initializes the logging framework.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu options for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to trigger network tests or clear logs.

methods.name: checkNetworkConnection
methods.description: Checks current network connection type (Wi-Fi or mobile) and logs the status.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the custom logging chain with wrap and filter nodes for display.
